description: Parali Brick Fuel Worker is responsible for assisting in the process of converting agricultural stubble (parali) into briquettes. The role involves operating and maintaining stubble briquetting machine, handling chemicals, binders, and nanomaterials (as per requirement) and ensuring the quality of the final product. The Parali Brick Fuel Machine Operator will work under the supervision of senior operators and follow safety protocols to ensure a safe and efficient production environment. This role plays a crucial part in reducing stubble burning and promoting energy practices.
